gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net strengthening of GBP 0.8 million in prior year claims reserves for 2021. This deterioration occurred despite a favourable movement of GBP 1.3 million in Covid-19 related losses. The 2020 year, which contributes to these prior year reserves, was significantly impacted by the Covid-19 pandemic and a high frequency of natural catastrophe events, suggesting that other adverse claims developments and catastrophe events offset the Covid-19 release, leading to the overall net strengthening. The claims development tables are distorted by significant Reinsurance to Close (RITC) adjustments, making direct calculation from them unreliable.

gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1861 opened 2021 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 770.971m. The syndicate recorded a small prior-year adverse development: a deterioration of GBP 0.8m (0.10% of opening gross claims) to claims reserves established at the prior year end (reported as pre-LPT). The report references broader influences including favourable Covid-19 movements (GBP 1.3m improvement) and an LPT transaction in December 2021 which ceded GBP 14m of premium to RiverStone; Part VII transfers and RITC adjustments during the year materially affect comparatives and technical reserve presentations.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 120.9m (2020: GBP 473.6m) is a deterioration of GBP 0.8m pre LPT (2020: deterioration of GBP 7.9m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end.
Despite further Covid-19 enforced restrictions in 2021, the Syndicate has had favourable movement in Covid-19 losses of GBP 1.3m.

In December 2021 CMA entered into a Loss Portfolio Transfer Reinsurance (LPT) agreement with RiverStone Managing Agency Limited ("RiverStone") covering the majority of classes of business no longer written by Syndicates 4444 (2020 & prior years of account) and 1861 (2020 year of account only).
The net impact to the Syndicate under the LPT is a 0.3% improvement on the combined ratio.
gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is explicitly stated in the notes as a GBP 0.8m deterioration (pre-LPT) and was used. Technical reserves and claim triangles are distorted by RITC and Part VII transactions (see RITC and Part VII notes and RITC adjustment in the reconciliations); where RITC/LPT adjustments exist the claims development triangle may be unreliable for calculating aggregate prior-year movements. No per-line-of-business prior-year reserve movements are provided.
